_comment: Example registry. Copy to jobs.json (gitignored) and replace these with your own jobs.
A job that is not listed here is invisible to the checker, so registering a job is
part of shipping it. Every entry needs a `fix`: what a human does about a finding,
as a command they can paste. The loader rejects an entry without one.

jobs.what: Snapshots the notes folder to the backup bucket
jobs.proof: a `nightly-backup done rc=0` trailer, with at least one `uploaded` line in the same run
jobs.notices: Me: no backup for over a day

jobs.what: A polling reader that rewrites its state file on every pass
jobs.trigger: a long-running agent session, every 15 minutes
jobs.fix: restart the reader session, then check its last error in the session log

jobs.trigger: GitHub Actions on push to main and pull_request, no interval
jobs.proof: the workflow is active and its last completed run succeeded
jobs.notices: Whoever is on call this week: main is red
jobs.fix: cd ~/code/main-repo && gh run list --workflow ci.yml --limit 3 && gh run view <id> --log-failed

jobs.what: Hourly Vercel cron that syncs the app's content
jobs.proof: the cron is enabled on the live deployment with the expected schedule, and the app answers
jobs.notices: Whoever owns the app: the cron is off, edited or unreachable
jobs.fix: vercel inspect --logs <deployment>; check Settings > Cron Jobs on the project

jobs.what: The scheduled wake that the 07:15-08:00 launchd jobs depend on to run awake
jobs.proof: `pmset -g sched` still shows a repeating wake at 07:10. macOS keeps exactly one repeat schedule, and an OS update can clear it without saying so.
jobs.notices: Me: the morning jobs will start in a DarkWake and fail with misleading errors

jobs.what: The checker's own entry: every other job must be evaluable
jobs.trigger: on demand, from whatever surface runs `jobwatch.py check`
jobs.proof: no other job came back `unknown`. A log that moved, a renamed workflow or a CLI that lost its auth turns a real check into `unknown` while the surface stays quiet, which reads as universal health.
jobs.notices: Me: a partly blind checker looks like a working one
jobs.fix: python3 jobwatch.py list, then fix the registry entry for each `unknown` row
